original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.

scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Four whole-helper assignments on selected PR1094: a width-seven vacancy path and a two-helper fill replace residuals 1+3+3 by 7.
scope_change_reason: The direct-relocation and one-blocker restrictions are replaced by a two-edge vacancy path and one exact suffix fill, preserving the local supplier and 144-call chronology.
bottleneck_link: Strictly decreases the complete complex moment while preserving rank mass and all inherited supplier assumptions.
stop_rule: Retain one four-placement witness; stop after independent ownership, both exact arithmetic engines, complete strict controller/invoice replay and focused packaging.
evidence: All eleven strict stages pass, with 102 negative controls and conditional kappa 0.001672664045494084, above selected PR1094 but below the earlier same-supplier PR1407 packing. This is a compact four-row alternative. Independent reviewer-reported CPython3.12 and seed67 audit passes are linked in VALIDATION.json.
